scope: Independent saved TRAIN arithmetic and source/protocol review; no new encoder or held-out quality experiment.

numeric_audit.execution: Python standard library in existing cuwacunu container; custom inert tensor reader, independent scalar reductions and likelihood derivatives

analytic_gradient.scope: F64 scalar chain rule on first8 TRAIN queries; local change4 partials with main32 fixed; finite differences perturb only the saved scalar likelihood algebra, not a network or model.

static_review.inert_reader: Whitelisted pickle globals map to data-only descriptors; no Torch import or learned module construction. Tensor storage offset/strides independently reconstructed in this audit.
static_review.TRAIN_boundary: All112 row IDs are unique ordered TRAIN anchors; head targets/group IDs/support match exactly; detailed queries match first8 anchors and exact past128 timestamp grids.
static_review.fixed_heads: All six stored D36 head seed identities and TRAIN feature/target means/scales checked; three ridge copies reassemble without fitting; neural predictions are read as saved data.
static_review.native_blocks: Fresh learned20 / analytic spectral12 / learned change4; covariance participation ratio is descriptive and scale-dependent.
static_review.query_reductions: Original supported target cells, equal eligible channel means and equal eligible example means retained; F64 operands precede arithmetic; omitted log(2pi) matches frozen NLL definition.
static_review.gradient_math: dL/dmu=e/v and dL/dv=(1/v-e^2/v^2)/2, multiplied by anchored-softplus variance derivative and canonical decoder/projection coefficients. Factor1/(8*eligible_channels*channel_target_cells) matches NLL; verified64 independent scalar likelihood finite differences.

interpretation_limits: TRAIN fits are in-sample diagnostics and do not establish generalization or forecasting.
Cellwise likelihood and analytic gradients cover only first8 saved TRAIN queries (1728 targets per stage);112-row aggregate summaries do not enlarge cellwise coverage.
The6.9424 variance/mean ratio compares local change4 partial gradients with main32 fixed; it is not the ratio of total parameter gradients or AdamW updates and does not prove causation.
Raw-coordinate covariance participation ratio depends on scale; fixed heads apply their saved TRAIN normalizers, so this alone does not prove loss of normalized representation dimension.
Aggregate JSON files contain both splits; only TRAIN fields are used numerically, while complete bytes are hashed for identity.
